design_strategy.visual_style: Digital Bureaucracy - Clean lines, high readability, subtle paper textures, authoritative typography

mono.usage: Use for reference numbers, dates, and technical data.

accent.usage: Focus rings, Highlights, Icon backgrounds, Step indicators (active state)

neutral.name: Official Grey
neutral.usage: Page backgrounds, Card backgrounds (secondary), Form inputs

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise or paper grain on backgrounds to give a 'printed document' feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (Regular weight for UI, Duotone for features).
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid strong gradients. Use subtle top-to-bottom fades (White to Gray-50) for section backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'border-l-4' on cards to indicate category or status (e.g., Red border for Urgent, Yellow for Pending).

hero_background.description: London Clock Tower/Skyline - Use with overlay for Hero Section context.

cultural_hero.description: Two women with colorful cloth - Use for 'Welcome' or 'Community' section to add warmth.

office_interior.description: Clean modern office - Use for 'Contact' or 'About' section background.

passport_doc.description: Red book/Passport - Use for 'Services' section or 'Documents' page.

landing_page.hero: Split layout or Centered with London skyline background (overlay: bg-black/50). Clear 'Book Appointment' button.
landing_page.services: Grid (Bento Mode A). Cards for: Fresh Registration, Renewal, GetFirst ID, Change of Particulars.
landing_page.info: Step-by-step process visualization (1. Choose Service -> 2. Select Date -> 3. Confirm).

booking_flow.steps: Progress bar at top. Clear 'Back' and 'Next' buttons.
booking_flow.calendar: Custom grid for Tuesday/Wednesday/Friday selection. Disabled weekends.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Left). Top bar with User Profile. Content area with Data Tables.
admin_dashboard.widgets: Stats cards at top (Total Appointments, Pending, Completed).

universal_guidelines: Use 'Inter' font for body text and 'Merriweather' for headings.
Primary button color is #D90000 (Red). Secondary is White/Gray.
Always use a 'container' class for page content.
Ensure high contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA compliant).
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Official/Government' aesthetic. Do not use gradients or flashy animations. Focus on clarity, speed, and trust. Use the provided image URLs for the landing page visuals. Implement the booking flow with strict validation (Tue/Wed/Fri only). Ensure the Admin panel is dense and functional.
